text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Ines! Been a minute! Guess you're<n>back to your
old shift schedule.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, yeah, sorry! I hope this place<n>wasn't too
short-staffed without me?

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
No wayyy! I'm happy you took that<n>time off! I was
worried you were<n>literally going to work till you
dropped.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Lemme know if you ever need me to<n>cover a shift.
Y'know, like, when you<n>have practice and stuff. Oh,
and any<n>time you feel like working, you're<n>welcome
to my shifts too.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: I wanna do anything I can to help you<n>out.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I've already adjusted your shift<n>schedule for
March. Make sure you<n>rest up after the Osaka Hai."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
First my coworker and now my<n>boss... Everyone's
getting ahead of<n>themselves trying to accommodate
me.
choice_data_list: That's because they're dreaming through you.
That's because they're dreaming through you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha. C'mon, all this talk of hopes and<n>dreams is a
little much, don't you<n>think?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I do want to be able to pay them back<n>for all their
support, you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, keep those expectations high!<n>I'll take them
with me to the track!
